name: Tim's Birthday
source:
Tim's Birthday uncovers the story of Anne, the protagonist and the older sister of Tim, who wakes up on the day of her brothers birthday hung over and has to slouch her way around the house and convince her little brother she wasn't doing "The Thing". As a player, you follow Anne through her attempts to make sure Tim has a great day but in the end it just only gets worse.

[From [url=https://kymarai.itch.io/tims-birthday]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《蒂姆的生日》揭开安妮的故事。她是本作主人公，也是蒂姆的姐姐，在弟弟生日当天宿醉醒来，只能拖着疲惫的身体在屋里晃荡，还要让弟弟相信自己没有做“那件事”。玩家将跟随安妮努力确保蒂姆度过美好的一天，但最后事态只会越来越糟。

[来源：[url=https://kymarai.itch.io/tims-birthday]itch.io[/url]]
